deliverable: Micro-Continual Benchmark Improvements: Preregistered Arms Implementation

summary.task: Identify micro_continual improvements from preregistrations and implement new learner factories

sections: Five identified arms with full rationale
Design rationale and error budget decomposition

1_contribution_preregistration.mechanism: RLS readout on penultimate features + residual head learning
1_contribution_preregistration.success_criterion: Held-out mean >0.86447, all 17 seeds individually positive

sections.mechanism: Permutation alignment detector from per-feature statistics
sections.key_insight: Input permutation is an identification problem, not a learning problem

sections.mechanism: Online class-conditional diagonal Gaussians with context cache
sections.key_insight: Learning problem is fundamentally a statistics problem

sections.mechanism: Frozen random features + per-regime RLS cache
sections.key_insight: Most learning is feature re-learning, not deep learning

2_new_directions.context: Pre-registered minimal validations (V1-V4) targeting the 0.135 error budget decomposition

3_forager_open_baselines.mechanism: On-policy actor-critic adapted to supervised continual streams
3_forager_open_baselines.purpose: Diagnostic arm — test whether RL optimization transfers to supervised setting
3_forager_open_baselines.note: Unlikely to beat champion, but negative result is informative

arms_implemented.name: rls_head_resid
arms_implemented.rationale: Tests whether deep readouts are necessary; RLS on fixed features + residual head learning

arms_implemented.name: alignment_first
arms_implemented.rationale: Permutation identification is combinatorial, not optimization; Hungarian algorithm on statistics

arms_implemented.name: naive_bayes_extended
arms_implemented.rationale: No-gradient baseline tests whether problem is statistics not optimization; context cache for recurrence

arms_implemented.name: dual_speed_rfs_rls
arms_implemented.rationale: Fixed random bank (0.848) vs champion (0.865) shows most learning is re-learning; context cache validates memory
arms_implemented.success_criterion: M1 baseline (control), M4 instant recovery if cache works

arms_implemented.name: actor_critic_micro
arms_implemented.rationale: Diagnostic — tests whether policy gradient optimization helps supervised continual learning
arms_implemented.success_criterion: Negative result (lags champion) is informative; positive result demands investigation

metadata_validation.description: Registry completeness, factory callability, hyperparameter types, preregistration references

factory_signatures.description: init_fn and step_fn signatures, state creation, metrics extraction

integration.description: micro_continual framework compatibility, MLP mock runs, registry structure

preregistration_consistency.description: Metrics embedding, source citations, hyperparameter coverage

step_1_add_to_registry.action: Import PREREGISTERED_ARMS and add to specs list

step_2_run_transfer_validation.command: .venv/bin/python -m alberta_framework.benchmarks.micro_continual ladder --family input_permutation --seeds 0 1 2 --arms sgd_raw adamw upgd_raw sgd_norm gated_norm naive_bayes rls_head_resid alignment_first naive_bayes_extended dual_speed_rfs_rls actor_critic_micro --out outputs/micro_continual/preregistered_ladder_v1
step_2_run_transfer_validation.exit_code_0: All arms completed; transfer_valid receipt written
step_2_run_transfer_validation.exit_code_2: Primary transfer-valid checks failed; receipt preserved

checks: alignment_first: first-window error >50% lower than champion?

step_4_record_outcome.table: Add results row for each arm with accuracy, vs-champion delta, notes

design_principles_embedded.preregistration_compliance: Each arm cites frozen preregistration document with success criteria
design_principles_embedded.minimal_validation: Each arm tests one hypothesis; smallest possible test
design_principles_embedded.seed_strategy: Development seeds consumed; held-out validation separate
design_principles_embedded.state_management: Factories use .get() with defaults, handle missing hyperparameters
design_principles_embedded.signature_compliance: All factories conform to MicroArmFactory type
design_principles_embedded.error_budget_targeting: Transient (alignment), re-learning (dual-speed), identification (alignment), representational memory (naive_bayes, dual-speed)

immediate: Add PREREGISTERED_ARMS to MICRO_ARM_REGISTRY in micro_continual.py
Run transfer validation ladder on M1 (input_permutation, seeds 0-2)
if_pass: Route rls_head_resid to full ipmnist_screening protocol (200-task)
Route alignment_first to 'genuinely new architectures' research lane
Route naive_bayes_extended + cache to M4 axis validation
Route dual_speed_rfs_rls to context-caching research track
if_fail: Record arm, criteria, outcome in NEGATIVE_RESULTS_LEDGER.md

evidence_promotion.note: All arms are diagnostics and explorations. None promote scientific claims. Integration validates signature/state compliance; measurement validates preregistration criteria.

quality_metrics.code_coverage: All five factories tested; all integration paths tested
quality_metrics.hyperparameter_validation: All hyperparameters typed and tested for defaults
quality_metrics.documentation_completeness: 450-line integration guide with rationale, criteria, next steps
